question: Which Article of the Constitution of India emphasises the provision of just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 42**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 42** of the Indian Constitution is part of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).
 
• This article directs the State to ensure the provision of **just and humane conditions of work** and **maternity relief.**
 
• The aim is to protect the rights and welfare of workers, particularly women, and promote social justice in the workplace.
 
• **Maternity relief** is vital to safeguard the health and well-being of mothers and newborns, ensuring that women are not disadvantaged due to pregnancy or childbirth.
 
• The inclusion of humane working conditions reflects the commitment of the Constitution to uphold **dignity, equality, and fairness** for all citizens.
 
• This article embodies the idea of a welfare state, focusing on the betterment of citizens' living and working standards.
 
• Though not enforceable by courts, the Directive Principles guide the State in formulating policies and laws to achieve constitutional goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 39**__

 __
 
• **Article 39** relates to the Directive Principles of State Policy and emphasizes the welfare of citizens.
 
• It focuses on securing adequate means of livelihood, ensuring equal pay for equal work, and safeguarding children and youth from exploitation.
 
• It aims to create a fair and equitable society by addressing fundamental inequalities.
 
 
 
• **Article 47**__
 __
 
• **Article 47** directs the State to raise the level of nutrition and standard of living of its people and improve public health.
 
• It emphasizes the prohibition of consumption of intoxicating drinks and drugs harmful to health.
 
• This article highlights the importance of a healthy population for the nation's development.
 
 
 
• **Article 44**__
 
 
• **Article 44** relates to the Directive Principles of State Policy and aims to secure a **Uniform Civil Code (UCC)** for all citizens throughout India.
 
• The UCC seeks to replace personal laws based on religion with a common set governing marriage, divorce, inheritance, and adoption.
 
• This article promotes national integration and equality among citizens.
